meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 把指定的 GitHub Pull Request 转成代码变更讲解视频：读取该 PR 的 diff、提交和文件，规划叙事，用 code-editorial 风格逐帧生成脚本、分镜和最终 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当用户给出 PR 的 URL、owner/repo#N，或在已检出的仓库里说“this PR”，并要求做成代码变更讲解视频时触发；产品宣传或非 PR 主题不走此技能。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#42 的改动做成 changelog 视频
say.note: 按 changelog 叙事生成分镜、旁白并渲染出 mp4。

say.text: 把当前仓库的 this PR 做成修复讲解视频
say.note: 在已检出仓库中使用，自动定位当前 PR 并制作视频。

howto.what_en: Converts a given GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: reads the PR's diff, commits, and files via gh, plans a narrative, and builds storyboard, script, frames, and a final mp4 in the fixed code-editorial style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user gives a PR URL, an owner/repo#N reference, or says "this PR" in a checked-out repo and asks for a code-change explainer video; not for product promos or non-PR topics.

say_en.text: Turn this PR https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 into an explainer video
say_en.note: It will read the PR diff, commits, and files, then produce script and video.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for owner/repo#42
say_en.note: It builds storyboard, narration, and renders an mp4 in changelog style.

say_en.text: Turn this PR in the current repo into a fix explainer video
say_en.note: Works in a checked-out repo; locates the current PR automatically.
